name: Debt aging buckets total the overdue sum
title: SC-09-01-02 Debt aging buckets total the overdue sum
description:
Verified by the test cases listed as steps. The Gherkin steps were not executed one by one.

Given the unit has overdue dues in several delay ranges
When the site manager opens the debt aging report
Then the aging buckets add up to the total overdue sum
